title: ComponentDTO
description: ComponentDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

componentId.description: The three digit code assigned by the source to identify the component.

componentTypeCode.description: Code used to identify the component type.

sampleAcquisitionMethodCode.description: Code used to identify the sample acquisition method.

basisCode.description: Code used to identify the moisture basis.

manufacturer.description: Name of the manufacturer or developer of the component.

modelVersion.description: The model of any hardware component or the version number of the software component.

hgConverterIndicator.description: For an Hg component, indicates whether the analyzer has a converter.

id.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring component record.

locationId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring location record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.
